query: image_z_image_turbo template with GGUF quants on Apple MPS (M4 MacBook Air 16GB): Q4_K/Q5_K quants produce noisy/black output while identical models work on NVIDIA; only Q3 runs reliably on macOS. Matches the MPS k-quant failure in #442.

desired.outcome: Maintainer (comfyui-wiki) linked #442 and stated the cause: GGUF models with 'k' in the quant naming cause this on MPS; suggested using other GGUF versions (e.g. non-k quant / Q3). OP never confirmed the swap worked.
desired.quality: Diagnosis identifies correct root cause; fix actionable and directionally correct.
